dedupe_keys.name: a hybrid mechanics guided machine learning based predictive framework for the performance of rocking foundations during earthquake loading

description: A hybrid mechanics-guided machine learning-based predictive framework for the performance of rocking foundations during earthquake loading is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sivapalan Gajan, State University of New York Polytechnic Institute (sunypoly.edu). Recent research findings reveal that rocking foundations during earthquake loading perform as efficient geotechnical seismic isolation mechanisms and have the potential to eliminate or reduce the damage to the building and bridge structures they support. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 6 top-level files (TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-vn5h-q719. Keywords: Rocking foundation, Shallow foundation, Soil-structure interation, Machine learning, Physics-guided machine learning. Published 2025-11-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
